소개 · THE BASICS

What is avocado cream?

Avocado cream is a face or body moisturiser that uses avocado as a key ingredient. The avocado fruit is naturally rich in oils, which is why it has been mashed into home face masks for generations. A finished cream takes that same idea and puts it into a stable, pleasant texture that you can use every day without any mess.

People often confuse it with the avocado cream sauce used in cooking. This page is only about skincare. If you came here looking for a product to put on your face at night, you are in the right place.

A good avocado cream feels rich without feeling greasy. It spreads easily, sinks in within a few minutes and leaves skin feeling soft the next morning. That balance is what we worked on with every jar in our range, and it is the main difference between a made cream and a fruit mask from the kitchen.

Because the texture is richer than a light gel, most people use avocado care in the evening. Night is when you are not wearing sunscreen or make-up, so a cushiony cream can stay on the skin undisturbed for hours. That is why two of our four jars are night creams, made in the style of a Korean night cream. You can read more in our guide, is avocado cream good for your skin.

성분 · INGREDIENTS

What is inside our avocado cream

Avocado does the comforting work, and three supporting ingredients round out the formula. Three of our four avocado creams contain them; Avocado Glow Cream 15g has only avocado and aloe vera. You can find the full ingredient list on each product page and on our ingredients page.

Avocado

The fruit behind avocado oil, which is high in oleic acid. In a cream it gives the rich, cushioned feel that makes dry skin feel comfortable.

Aloe vera

Aloe vera is widely used in cosmetics for its light, fresh feel. It balances the richness of avocado so the cream does not sit heavily on the skin.

Vitamin B3

Also called niacinamide, vitamin B3 is one of the most popular skincare ingredients for a smooth, refined-looking surface.

Kojic acid

Kojic acid is used in cosmetics made for a brighter, more even-looking tone. Read our kojic acid guide for details.

효과 · BENEFITS

Benefits of avocado cream for skin

We describe our creams in cosmetic terms, because that is what they are. They are not medicines and they do not treat skin conditions. With that said, here is what regular use is designed to do.

Skin that feels soft and comfortable

The rich texture forms a comfortable layer that helps reduce the tight, dry feeling many people notice after washing their face. This is the benefit most customers notice first, often from the very first night.

A hydrated, smooth look

When skin is well moisturised, it reflects light more evenly. Fine dry lines look softer and make-up sits better the next day. Aloe vera in the formula adds to the fresh, hydrated feel.

A more even-looking tone over time

Vitamin B3 and kojic acid are included to support a brighter, more even-looking complexion with regular use. This kind of change is gradual. Give any new cream at least a few weeks of steady use before you judge it.

A calm evening ritual

Skincare works best when you enjoy it enough to keep doing it. A cream that feels and smells pleasant is easier to use every night, and consistency matters more than any single ingredient. Our guide is avocado cream good for your skin explains this in more depth.

선택 · CHOOSING

Which avocado cream is right for you?

Start with what you want from the cream, and then look at size and budget. These short guides cover the most common situations.

If your skin feels dry or tight

Choose the Avocado Night Cream with Kojic Acid. It is the biggest jar at 30 g, so you can apply it generously every night, and it works out cheapest per gram.

If you want a more even-looking tone

Choose the Avocado Korean Night Cream. It follows a Korean-inspired approach, pairing avocado with vitamin B3 and kojic acid for a softer, smoother and more even-looking complexion.

If you are new to avocado care

Start with the Avocado Glow Nourishing Skin Cream. At 10 g and ₹349 it is a low-risk way to see how your skin likes the texture before you buy a full-size jar.

If you have oily or combination skin

You can still enjoy a rich cream. Use a smaller amount, about the size of a pea, and apply it only at night. Many people with combination skin apply more on the cheeks and less on the forehead and nose.

If you have sensitive skin

Do a patch test first, as you should with any new product. Apply a little cream behind the ear or on the inner arm, wait 24 hours, and continue only if your skin feels comfortable. If you are under a doctor's care for a skin condition, ask them before adding new products.

사용법 · HOW TO USE

How to use avocado cream in your routine

A rich cream is always the last step of an evening routine, because it seals in everything you applied before it. Follow these steps in order.

  1. Cleanse. Wash your face with a gentle cleanser to remove sunscreen, make-up and the day's dust.
  2. Tone. If you use a toner, pat it in while your skin is still slightly damp.
  3. Treat. Apply any serum or targeted product next, and give it a minute to settle.
  4. Moisturise. Take a pea-sized amount of cream, warm it between your fingertips and press it gently into the face and neck.
  5. Protect in the morning. Finish your morning routine with sunscreen. This matters even more when your routine includes kojic acid.

Use upward, outward strokes and avoid pulling the skin around the eyes. More cream does not mean better results. A thin, even layer is enough, and it helps the jar last longer.

How often should you apply it? Most people use it once a day, at night. If you are new to kojic acid, begin with every second night for the first two weeks and then move to nightly use. Our article can I use avocado night cream every night walks through this step by step.

For a complete evening plan, see how to build a simple night skincare routine.

홈메이드 · HOMEMADE OR READY-MADE

Homemade avocado mask or ready-made cream?

Mashing a ripe avocado into a face mask is a pleasant weekend treat, and we have written a guide on how to make avocado night cream at home. It is worth knowing the limits, though.

Fresh fruit spoils quickly. A homemade mix has no preservative system, so it needs to be made fresh each time and washed off after a short while. It cannot be left on overnight, and it should never be stored for days in the bathroom.

A ready-made cream is designed to be stable, hygienic and consistent from the first use to the last. It also includes ingredients you cannot easily add at home, such as vitamin B3 and kojic acid in controlled amounts. For daily care, a made cream is the practical choice, and a fresh mask can stay an occasional extra.

비교 · HOW IT COMPARES

Avocado cream compared with other moisturisers

Moisturisers come in several textures, and each has its place. Knowing where a rich avocado formula sits helps you decide when to reach for it.

Compared with a gel moisturiser

Gels are light, water-based and quick to absorb. They feel great in humid weather and on oily skin, but they can leave dry skin wanting more by the middle of the night. An avocado cream is richer and stays comfortable for longer, which is why it suits the evening.

Compared with a body lotion

Body lotions are made to spread over large areas and are usually too thin and too fragranced for the face. A face cream is more concentrated, and a small amount goes a long way. Keep each product for the job it was made for.

Compared with a plain cold cream

A traditional cold cream gives moisture and little else. Our avocado creams add aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid, so you get the comfort of a rich cream along with care for a smoother, more even-looking finish.

계절 · SEASONS

Using your cream through the Indian seasons

India's weather changes a great deal across the year, and your skin notices. You do not need a different product for each season. Small changes in how much you apply are usually enough.

Summer

Heat and sweat make rich textures feel heavier. Use half your usual amount, apply it only at night, and let it settle for ten minutes before you sleep. An air-conditioned room dries the skin, so a night cream is still useful.

Monsoon

Humidity is high, and skin can feel sticky. Cleanse well in the evening, keep the layer thin, and focus the cream on areas that still feel dry, such as the cheeks and around the mouth.

Winter

This is when rich creams are most welcome. Cold, dry air pulls moisture from the skin, so apply a full pea-sized amount, or a little more, and include your neck. Many people in North India find they want a richer layer from November to February.

Three common mistakes to avoid

  • Using too much. A thick layer does not work harder. It only sits on the surface and transfers to your pillow.
  • Skipping sunscreen. Night care and daytime sun protection work together. One does not replace the other.
  • Changing products too quickly. Give a new cream several weeks. Switching every few days makes it impossible to know what suits your skin.

구매 팁 · BUYING TIPS

5 tips for buying avocado cream in India

There are many avocado products sold online, and quality varies a lot. These five checks help you compare any cream, including ours.

  1. Read the ingredient list. Avocado should be named clearly, along with the other key ingredients the brand talks about.
  2. Compare price per gram. Jar sizes range from 10 g to 100 g, so the sticker price alone can mislead. Divide the price by the weight.
  3. Check who makes and sells it. Buy from the brand's own website or an authorised seller so that you receive a genuine, fresh product.
  4. Look at the pack details. A proper cosmetic label shows the batch number, the manufacturing date and the use-before date.
  5. Be careful with big promises. A cosmetic cream can make skin look and feel better. It cannot change your skin overnight, and honest brands do not claim that it can.

How to store your cream

Keep the jar closed tightly, away from direct sunlight and heat. Indian summers can be harsh on creams, so a cool cupboard is better than a window shelf. Use clean, dry fingers or a small spatula, and always check the use-before date printed on the pack.

자주 묻는 질문 · FAQ

Avocado cream questions and answers

Is avocado cream good for the face?

Yes, a well-made cream is a comfortable moisturiser for most skin types, especially dry and normal skin. We cover this fully in is avocado cream good for your skin and face.

Can I use it during the day?

You can. The Avocado Glow Nourishing Skin Cream suits day or night. Use a small amount in the morning and always follow with sunscreen. Our two night creams are best kept for the evening.

Is avocado night cream good for dry skin?

Rich creams are generally a good match for dry skin because they help it feel soft and comfortable overnight. See is avocado night cream good for more.

Does avocado help with skin brightening?

Avocado itself is mainly about nourishment and comfort. In our creams, vitamin B3 and kojic acid are the ingredients included for a brighter, more even-looking tone. Read is avocado cream good for your skin.

How long does one jar last?

With a pea-sized amount each night, a 25 g to 30 g jar typically lasts around four to six weeks. The 10 g jar is a trial and travel size and lasts about two weeks of nightly use.

Can men use it?

Yes. Skin needs moisture regardless of gender. The creams are suitable for both women and men.

Can I use it with a glutathione cream?

Yes. Apply the lighter product first and the richer one last. Many customers pair an avocado night cream with our Glutathione Cream.

Which is the best avocado cream to start with?

If you want to test the texture, start with the 10 g Avocado Glow Nourishing Skin Cream. If you already know you like rich night creams, go straight to the 30 g Avocado Night Cream for the best value.
